resources.string: Says so at once when you ask in a language BOAR doesn\'t speak yet, instead of a confused answer.
Sorry, BOAR doesn\'t speak {{language}} yet. Ask in English.

• A full question in a language other than English\n• Other alphabets by their letters: Russian, Ukrainian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew, Hindi, Thai, Greek and more\n• Languages in the Latin alphabet (French, German, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Turkish) when the phone\'s language detector is sure
Как долго нужно кипятить воду, чтобы она была безопасной?
烧水需要多长时间才能安全饮用？
Wie lange dauert es, bis das Wasser kocht?

Short messages, thanks and greetings, names, quotes, code and links go to the model as usual, and so does a question with English in it (What does \'merci\' mean?). A short follow-up in a chat already going goes to the model too. The answer\'s details say Tool: language. Without the phone\'s language detector (Android 10 and later) only other alphabets get the reply.
